name: Evelyn Regner - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on Banking Union – annual report 2025
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its views on how the Banking Union should develop. It is an opinion, not a new law. It asks for the Banking Union to be completed with a common EU scheme that protects savers' deposits, so that savers get the same protection everywhere. It also calls for better protection for borrowers, closer watching of risks outside banks, and fairer access to banking services for people and small businesses.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. It is a set of requests to the European Commission and EU governments.
- **Who it affects:** Savers, borrowers, small businesses and banks across the EU.
- **What happens next:** The Commission and governments decide whether to act on these requests.
